content:
We have a task: build complete route JSON. We have template search result: mapped_rxn and template_id 1679747. Apply_template gave precursors list: ['COc1ccc(C(=O)c2ccc(OC)cc2)cc1', '[Li]C[Si](C)(C)C'].

But verify_step returned False, meaning that applying that template to those precursors does NOT give target molecule COc1ccc(C=Cc2ccc(OC)cc2)cc1? Wait target is maybe the alkene product: COc1ccc(C=Cc2ccc(OC)cc2)cc1 (a stilbene derivative). The precursors: a ketone (aryl-CO-aryl) and a silyl carbanion [Li]C[Si](C)(C)C (trimethylsilyl methyl lithium). The Peterson reaction: carbonyl + silyl carbanion gives beta-hydroxy silane then elimination to alkene. So the forward reaction: carbonyl + silyl carbanion -> alkene + LiO? Actually product is alkene plus Li[O-] and Si? The template may need to include the carbonyl and silyl reagent. The verify_step false maybe because template expects carbonyl with O= C and silyl group attached to carbon (alpha-silyl carbanion). Our precursors: carbonyl is correct, silyl carbanion is LiC[Si](C)(C)C (a silyl carbanion). Should be correct. Maybe the target SMILES we used is wrong: The product from template mapping is [CH2:1]=[C:2]... which is a double bond between CH2 and carbonyl carbon? Actually mapping shows CH2 from silyl carbanion attaches to carbonyl carbon, forming alkene with aromatic groups. So product is COc1ccc(C=Cc2ccc(OC)cc2)cc1 indeed. So why verify false? Possibly template_id expects SMARTS format "[C:1][O:2]>>[C:1][C:2]" etc. Our template_id is numeric but verify_step expects SMARTS string? It says template in SMARTS format. We passed numeric ID, causing mismatch. So need to retrieve SMARTS template via get_template. Let's get template.
